show.description: Thrown out by his wife and family, a man is mocked as useless, unaware to them that he is actually a powerful hidden CEO. Betrayed and humiliated, he begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel. Once his true identity is revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.
